description: This file defines a configuration class and methods for integrating with the DataForSEO SERP API, including request transformation and response parsing specifically tailored to DataForSEO's API format.

classes.name: DataForSEOSearchConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for DataForSEO SERP API, providing methods to get API details, validate environment, transform search requests and responses.

methods.name: str ui_friendly_name()
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for the DataForSEO provider.

methods.name: Literal["GET","POST"] get_http_method(self)
methods.description: Specifies that the API uses POST requests.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Prepares the request headers with Basic Auth credentials sourced from environment variables or input api_key.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], optional_params: dict, data: Optional[Union[Dict, List[Dict]]] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL, defaulting to constants or environment variable.

methods.name: Union[Dict,List[Dict]] transform_search_request( self, query: Union[str, List[str]], optional_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Converts a generic search query and parameters into DataForSEO-specific request format.

methods.name: SearchResponse transform_search_response( self, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Parses DataForSEO API responses and maps them to the standard SearchResponse format, extracting search results.
